nodes.name: Start
nodes.pseudocode: Entry point. Bootstraps the TodoManager and wires up event listeners.

nodes.name: TodoManager
nodes.pseudocode: Central class that owns the todo list state and exposes mutation methods.

nodes.name: items: Todo[]
nodes.pseudocode: Private array holding all Todo objects currently in the list.

nodes.name: nextId: number
nodes.pseudocode: Auto-incrementing counter used to assign unique IDs to new todos.

nodes.name: addTodo(text)
nodes.pseudocode: Validates that text is non-empty, constructs a new Todo object { id, text, done: false }, pushes it to this.items, then calls saveToDisk().

nodes.name: removeTodo(id)
nodes.pseudocode: Filters this.items to exclude the item whose id matches the argument. Calls saveToDisk() after mutation.

nodes.name: toggleDone(id)
nodes.pseudocode: Finds the item with the matching id and flips its done boolean. Calls saveToDisk() after mutation.

nodes.name: getAll()
nodes.pseudocode: Returns a shallow copy of this.items so callers cannot mutate internal state directly.

nodes.name:
Input
Valid?
nodes.pseudocode: Checks that the provided text argument is a non-empty string after trimming whitespace.

nodes.name: renderList()
nodes.pseudocode: Clears the DOM list element and re-renders each item in TodoManager.getAll() as a <li> with a toggle checkbox and a delete button.

nodes.name: End
nodes.pseudocode: App fully initialised and reactive. All user events handled by listeners.
